name: Reboot and Update
description: Update the add-on from GitHub and reboot the Pi.

led_messages.label: Add-on update available
led_messages.description: A newer version of this add-on is on GitHub.

led_messages.label: DreamPi update available
led_messages.description: DreamPi has newer scripts than the Pi has.

led_messages.label: Update running
led_messages.description: An update of the add-on is in progress.

led_messages.label: Update done
led_messages.description: The add-on was updated (for 10 minutes afterwards).

led_messages.label: Update failed
led_messages.description: The update of the add-on failed (for 10 minutes afterwards).

led_messages.label: About to reboot
led_messages.description: A reboot was requested; the Pi goes down in a moment.
